# rail_bindings

Rail bindings records in Operations Desk. Product articles define their operational scope.

Read this collection using `search_records(resource="rail_bindings", filters={}, cursor=0, limit=20)` or `get_record(resource="rail_bindings", record_id="<returned id>")`.

**Filters:** exact scalar equality; in, contains, gte and lte operator objects on supported top-level fields. See DB-query-syntax for type and null behavior.

Search returns selected summary fields, so omission from a summary is not proof of absence from the complete record. Read detail before interpreting an optional field. Fields depend on the record type and processing stage; null and absent fields are not zero amounts. Types below describe public record shapes, rather than mandatory properties on every row.

## Explicit identifier relationships

- `site_id` references a `rail_sites` record ID when present. See `DB-rail_sites`.
- `account_id` references a `desk_accounts` record ID when present. See `DB-desk_accounts`.

Commercial references can require entity, period or issuer matching. An ID relationship does not imply that every related record repeats the same case_id.

## Fields

| Field | Observed public types | Search use | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account_id` | string | Top-level filter | Record ID in desk_accounts. Use get_record on that collection; the link does not make other rows implicitly belong to the same object. |
| `business_area` | string | Top-level filter | Business area: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `id` | string | Top-level filter | Opaque record key used by get_record; obtain it from returned records or explicit references. It is not an amount, date or proof of business identity. |
| `rail` | string | Top-level filter | Rail: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `reviewed_minute` | integer | Top-level filter | Reviewed minute: logical minute or duration, as indicated by the field name; compare with get_clock and the applicable event/validity terms. |
| `scope` | string | Top-level filter | Access namespace for the record. It is not a customer name or a universal case_id. |
| `site_id` | string | Top-level filter | Record ID in rail_sites. Use get_record on that collection; the link does not make other rows implicitly belong to the same object. |
| `status` | string | Top-level filter | Current state of this particular object. A proposal or submission state is distinct from a posted payment or completed review. Public values represented here: `READY`. This list describes the documented records, not an input-validation enum. |
| `tested_minute` | integer | Top-level filter | Tested minute: logical minute or duration, as indicated by the field name; compare with get_clock and the applicable event/validity terms. |
